name: Analytical Integration of Scattering Phase Function for Random Polygons
aliases: Projected area and diffuse/specular integration for random polygons
definition: Computes the contribution of a random collection of small polygons (total area 1) to the radiative transfer equation by analytically integrating projected area, diffuse reflection, and specular terms over angular bins of surface normals, neglecting mutual occlusion.
summary: This method analytically integrates projected area and reflection terms for random polygons to efficiently compute scattering phase functions for vegetation-like media, avoiding numerical Monte Carlo approaches.
